$comment: Known flakes: checks that fail now and then on the released pair as on a candidate, each with the condition it shows under (load average, CPU throttle, concurrency) and how often. A flake seen outside its condition, or more often than recorded, is a red. Read by scripts/run-browser-probes.mjs (reported beside the run); the gates named here (first-paint gate 24, FS-10 runs, the owner remarks register) are run by hand and read this list in their evidence. Taken by the group build 18 pre-cut (DEV msg-5ee6d5bacd684276a776, answer 9).

first-paint-gate drawer bare tag.says: drawer «bare tag: no frame before the code», a different example each run, mostly @390
first-paint-gate drawer bare tag.condition: load average above about 11 (seen at 11-72) with FIRST_PAINT_CONCURRENCY=1; not seen at load 13-16 on the pair or below 12
first-paint-gate drawer bare tag.rate: drawer alone, pair and candidate alternating at load 11-27: pair 1 of 216, candidate 2 of 216; full gate b1 at load 15-27: 3 of 3920; b2 and b6 at load 41-58: 0 of 3920

icon subset font fallback.gate: any page under timing-hostile delays (FS-10 runs: probe/fs10.mjs)
icon subset font fallback.says: console warning «icon subset font fallback applied»; the full icon font draws, no glyph is missing
icon subset font fallback.condition: CPU throttled x4 with every script and sheet delayed 0-600 ms, or a smoke run at load above about 40
icon subset font fallback.rate: 1 of 240 FS-10 loads (CPU x4); once in a b1 smoke under load

preloaded but not used.says: Chrome «The resource ... was preloaded using link preload but not used within a few seconds»
preloaded but not used.condition: after the load event, scripts and sheets delayed 0-600 ms (1200 ms with 6 pages at once); accepted by the dispatcher decision of group build 18
preloaded but not used.rate: pair 26-51 warnings in 6-8 of 30 loads, candidate 0-50 in 0-8 of 30 (at or below the pair in every run)

register VL-06 VL-41 filter apply.owner: the register probe (DEV), not View or the Framework
register VL-06 VL-41 filter apply.says: VL-06 / VL-41 filter apply fails: the probe presses where «Применить» stood before a scroll moved the anchored window
register VL-06 VL-41 filter apply.condition: any load; more often under load (7 of 10) and with CPU x4 (0 of 30); the probe fix proposed to DEV gives 30/30
